title: VarNet
paper_title: End-to-End Variational Networks for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction
core_mech: 灵敏度估计网络加多级 k-space variational cascades，将图像正则与采样点 DC 工程化为统一流程。
core_mech_en: End-to-End Variational Network combining a joint U-Net coil sensitivity estimation module (SME) with K k-space variational cascades using U-Net image regularizers.
input_desc: 欠采样多线圈 k-space y 与采样掩膜 M
input_en: Raw undersampled multi-coil k-space y and Cartesian undersampling mask M (including auto-calibration lines)
output_desc: 灵敏度组合后的 MRI 幅度图 x_hat
output_en: Root-sum-of-squares or coil-combined MRI magnitude image x̂

source.title: VarNet
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

adapter.name: VarNet
adapter.mechanism: Original fastMRI sensitivity estimation and normalized-U-Net k-space cascades.
limitations: Two cascades, smaller widths and four calibration lines; synthetic phantom MSE replaces the original benchmark training loss/data.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
